note: Internal candidate/QA stage contract. Ontology v0.2 and StructuralDetectionEvidence v0.2 handoff are active. Candidates still require all promotion gates; this contract does not make candidates ground truth or activate training readiness.

semantic_context_contract.rule: G3-class-semantics MUST apply this contract's hard gates, review triggers, and contextual priors; contextual priors are never sufficient alone for promotion.

gates.control: required-fields, finite values, version, allowed class and QA-state are valid
box has positive area, is within source-page bounds, and coordinate_space is explicit source-page
apply structural-layout-context-v0.1 hard gates, review triggers and contextual priors; visible drawing evidence must support the class and context alone cannot create an element
box is tight around the visible target instance; does not include unrelated text/dimensions/grids and does not infer hidden continuation
ambiguous-class, ambiguous-presence or overlap-ambiguous blocks promotion; no-safe-box is not a negative label
no duplicate instance and no exact/near-duplicate leakage across project-group train/validation/test splits
stable candidate ID, source/page/project-group, candidate generator version, evidence/reason and review state are preserved; human QA is required when the annotation spec requires it

semantic_qa_requirements.grid: no-grid is valid; do not invent grids; grid alignment is context only; off-grid candidates are reviewed
semantic_qa_requirements.column: do not create at every grid intersection; missing visible column is not proof of absence; regular spacing is not sufficient to create a column
semantic_qa_requirements.cross-level_column: repetition at corresponding positions is supporting context only; appearance/disappearance/relocation/offset/section-or-symbol-change routes to review; never hallucinate a column on one level because it exists on another
semantic_qa_requirements.beam: beam-to-column, beam-to-wall and beam-to-beam relationships are contextual evidence only; detector box corners are not engineering endpoints
semantic_qa_requirements.wall: partition-like graphics or location alone cannot promote a structural wall; shear/core walls are counterexamples to automatic nonstructural classification; unresolved wall semantics must not enter approved labels
